title: 赤沙竞途

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮登记：一位驾车者、左白右黑双马与战车位于赤沙峡道，实体沙道延至底边，马头和主要蹄腿可辨。未做审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original opaque 1024x1536 vertical tarot master for The Chariot, theme 赤沙竞途 / Red Sand Run. Keep the reference card's identity: exactly ONE charioteer in cobalt and deep violet, exactly TWO harnessed horses charging together, WHITE on image LEFT, BLACK on image RIGHT, pulling ONE complete chariot; reins visibly connect hands, bridles and vehicle. Invent a red desert canyon race route from a very low front-side camera. Canyon walls recede behind, horse heads remain separate, every essential leg and hoof is legible, common direction unmistakable. Palette red sandstone, cobalt blue, copper gold, natural skin. A broad SOLID sand road with wheel tracks occupies the foreground and continues to the bottom edge, not just little sand clumps beneath hooves; wheels and hooves have contact shadows. Detailed painterly fantasy tarot with a fine celestial gold border, dynamic dust kept low and away from legs. No extra rider or horse, no missing wheel, no text, title, letters, numbers, watermark or logo. One full opaque image.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.

Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture. Image 1 is the edit target; opaque background plate.
generationRuns.conclusion: Generated candidate; user requested collective visual acceptance later.
